tools.name: google_list_files
tools.description: List files and subfolders in the configured Google Drive project folder or one of its descendant folders. Sharing and permission settings cannot be changed by agents.

parent_id.description: Optional Google Drive folder ID. It must be the configured root folder or a descendant. Omit to list the project root folder.

page_size.description: Maximum number of files to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: google_search_files
tools.description: Search file and folder names recursively within the configured Google Drive project folder.

query.description: Text contained in the file or folder name.

mime_type.description: Optional exact Google Drive MIME type filter.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: google_read_file
tools.description: Read the content of a non-folder file inside the configured Google Drive project folder. Google Docs are returned as structured text; binary files are returned as bounded base64 content.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID inside the configured project folder.

tools.name: google_read_document
tools.description: Read the text and current revision of a Google Docs document inside the configured project folder.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of a Google Docs document inside the configured project folder.

tools.name: google_create_folder
tools.description: Create a subfolder inside the configured Google Drive project folder or one of its descendant folders.

parent_id.description: Optional descendant folder ID. Omit to create the folder in the project root.

tools.name: google_create_document
tools.description: Create a Google Docs document inside the configured Google Drive project folder or a descendant folder.

name.description: Name of the new Google Docs document.

parent_id.description: Optional descendant folder ID. Omit to create the document in the project root.

initial_text.description: Optional initial text to insert into the new document.

tools.name: google_create_document_from_template
tools.description: Copy a Google Docs template that is inside the configured project folder into the project folder or a descendant folder.

template_file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of a Google Docs template inside the configured project folder.

parent_id.description: Optional descendant folder ID. Omit to create the document in the project root.

tools.name: google_update_document
tools.description: Apply Google Docs batch update operations to a document inside the configured project folder. Provide the revision ID from google_read_document to reject stale edits.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the document to update.

requests.description: One or more Google Docs API request objects, each containing exactly one operation.

required_revision_id.description: Revision ID returned by google_read_document. The update is rejected if the document changed since it was read.

tools.name: google_move_file
tools.description: Move a file or subfolder to another folder inside the configured Google Drive project folder. It cannot move anything outside the project folder.

file_id.description: Google Drive file or folder ID to move.

parent_id.description: Destination folder ID inside the configured project folder.

tools.name: google_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file or descendant subfolder inside the configured Google Drive project folder. The root folder cannot be deleted. Sharing and permission settings are not changed.

file_id.description: Google Drive file or descendant folder ID to delete.

tools.name: google_export_file
tools.description: Export a Google Docs document inside the configured project folder as base64-encoded content, for example DOCX or PDF.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the document to export.

mime_type.description: Export MIME type. Defaults to DOCX.

root_folder_id.label: Google Drive project folder ID or URL
root_folder_id.description: Agents can manage files and subfolders in this folder only. Sharing and permissions remain human-only.
